findings.description: The razor does not consistently occupy the same position relative to the face in the direct view and reflection. At the opening, the directly visible razor is at the underside of the chin while its reflection is at the upper lip. Around 00:03, the directly visible blade passes over the hair near the temple while the reflected blade crosses the bare forehead; around 00:08–00:09, the direct view places it beneath the chin while the reflection places it on the cheek. These simultaneous contact locations do not match.
